name: TO-108
note: Linear transponder for SSB and CW.
amsatStatusSource: AMSAT status page satellite list (https://www.amsat.org/status/), checked 2026-10-19

profile.builtBy: CAMSAT, China, as a payload on the TianQin-1 test satellite
profile.story: CAS-6 is CAMSAT’s amateur payload riding on a technology test satellite. Its linear transponder works, but a computer fault knocked out the CW beacon and telemetry, and the transponder switches on and off every few seconds, so expect a choppy downlink.
